name: Betrayed by Light
body:
School transmutation; Level adept 2, antipaladin 2, bard 2, cleric/oracle 2, druid 2, inquisitor 2, lathspell 2, occultist 2, paladin 2, shaman 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, white necromancer 2, witch 2

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a prism)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You alter the target so that they are harmed by the ambient light around them. If the creature fails their Fortitude save, they are sickened and take 1 fire damage per round when they begin their turn in or enter areas of normal light. In areas of bright light this increases to nauseated and 1d4 fire damage. This affects creatures, like undead, who are normally immune to conditions that have Fortitude saves. If the target succeeds on their Fortitude save, they are sickened while in bright light but take no damage and are not affected by normal light.

Betrayed by Light, Mass

School transmutation; Level adept 4, antipaladin 4, bard 4, cleric/oracle 4, druid 4, inquisitor 4, lathspell 4, occultist 4, paladin 4, shaman 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, white necromancer 4, witch .

Targets one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart

This spell functions as betrayed by light except as notated above.
